title: From Unit Activity to Human Orderliness: A State-Dynamic Reconstruction of Coexistence
description: A source-bounded qualitative reconstruction linking intrinsic unit activity, compositional closure, constitutionally complete jeevan, animal and human joint forms, reflexive evaluation, and public orderliness. It distinguishes dharma and niyati-kram from causal forces, preserves composition and atomic development as separate lines, and keeps unresolved empirical mechanisms explicit.
